SC1.reason: Agree with Approach B (`mori_core::stage::sequence::Sequence`) over Approach A (`start_successor` with an externally supplied `CompletePrefix`). In the current stage API, `StageOutcome::Complete` retains only the final `StageSegment`, so a bare `Complete` loses earlier `Waiting` segments, prior attempted work, and unselected global frame state. Approach A would immediately require inventing and validating an external full-prefix carrier across calls (forcing premature resolution of persistent reopen/identity rules under OD2/OD7) while still needing the same internal projection, lifting, and accounting logic. Approach B directly closes the boundary gap in-process by owning the global `Snapshot` head, active continuation, and complete call/effect prefixes, ensuring `Sequence::next` transitions strictly from the actual completed predecessor head without accepting caller-supplied successor state or prior accounting.

summary: Recommend Approach B (`recommend-B-conditional`) with `agree` on SC1–SC6, strictly conditioned on designated-owner contracts OD1–OD8 and independent expectation derivation (`CSQ-015`) prior to implementation integration. Owning the global `Snapshot` head, outside frame, active continuation, and complete call/effect prefixes inside `mori_core::stage::sequence::Sequence` cleanly supports completed-predecessor-to-successor execution (`P -> Q`) over existing `stage::load`, `stage::start`, `stage::resume`, and `stage::outcome_report` without trusting caller-supplied successor state or prematurely inventing an unauthenticated external `CompletePrefix` reopen carrier (Approach A). Minor design refinements are noted for per-invocation binding injectivity, R7 (`canonical_boundary`) interactions with incoming duties on awaiting actions under OD1, and explicit wire definitions for expanded `PrefixObservation` test fixtures.
